algebraic_kernel_cone_lemma.statement: For every finite diagram of finite free integral C0-C2 complexes and chain maps, define C3(x)=ker(d2_x), d3_x as inclusion, and C3(f) as the restriction of C2(f). This is a finite strict functor, d2*d3=0, and every integral kernel class has a coherent integral filler. All category relations, arbitrary face flags, automorphisms, monodromy, and active-block permutations are inherited exactly.
proof_dependencies: A subgroup of a finite-rank free abelian group is finite-rank free.
A chain map sends ker(d2) into ker(d2).
The inclusion ker(d2)->C2 has boundary equal to the represented kernel cycle.
algebraic_kernel_cone_lemma.consequence_for_falsification: No obstruction using only integral boundary algebra, finite specialization-category coherence, monodromy, or permutation equivariance can disprove the target. Any valid obstruction must use the missing geometric realization/properness/true-infinity semantics.
